title: Never working in New Orleans; Louisiana musicians
summary: He only passed through New Orleans with the Wild West show but played with many Louisiana musicians.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Speaking of New Orleans, did you ever get there to work there or go down?
Well, I was getting through there with the Wild West show. I was sitting up on a bandwagon. But I never did go down there on a date.
Did you hear any music there at all when you went through?

Yeah, just rode through. But I was born and raised 30 miles from Sweet Sport, Louisiana. And I played with many Louisiana musicians from Alexandria, Louisiana, and Sweet Sport, Louisiana, and other points in Louisiana. And all of them, to me, had good rhythms and good perception of music.
